title: Ep 35 — OpenAI Kills the Voice Relay Race, and the Text-a-Receipt App That Tracked Five Million Dollars
description: OpenAI ships a live voice model that listens and talks at once, Cursor launches an autonomous Projects coordinator, Google brings a native Gemini app to Windows, and Lovable opens a builder marketplace. Plus a deep dive on Receipt-AI, the text-a-photo expense tracker that grew to five million dollars in tracked receipts, and an eighteenth straight quiet week for UK sports-venue EV charging.
